claims.statement: An associational contrast is a functional of the observed joint distribution and does not, by itself, identify a potential-outcome contrast.
Predictive generalization concerns unseen draws from a stated prediction target and does not identify intervention effects.
A counterfactual claim requires an intervention definition, an estimand, and identification assumptions beyond predictive fit.
Operational claims concern a versioned pipeline, its monitoring, and its rollback rules; even an executable artifact only marks operational readiness, never causal validity.
For each unit and actually received treatment, the observed outcome equals the corresponding potential outcome under a well-defined treatment version; this premise is substantive and unverified here.
A unit's potential outcomes do not depend on other units' treatment assignments under the declared exposure model; this premise is substantive and unverified here.
Conditional mean exchangeability holds given the declared baseline covariates; this is an untestable assumption, not a balance-test conclusion.
Every covariate pattern in the target support has strictly positive probability of either treatment level; clipping does not repair structural nonpositivity.
A declared baseline adjustment set blocks the declared backdoor paths for the declared causal question; selecting the set is a substantive modeling decision, not a balance-check or tuning result.

The identification conjunction contains consistency, noninterference, conditional mean exchangeability, positivity on target support, and a valid baseline adjustment set; none of the five atoms is certified here.

If consistency, noninterference, conditional mean exchangeability, positivity on target support, and a valid baseline adjustment set all hold, then the interventional mean is recovered from the observed distribution by covariate standardization. This is the implication only; whether the premises hold is substantive and remains unverified.
Only conditionally on the full five-atom identification conjunction is the ATE identified from the observed distribution; no premise is certified by this syntactic derivation.
The implemented AIPW score adds inverse-propensity residual corrections to the outcome-regression contrast; cross-fitting separates nuisance fitting from score evaluation on train folds.
The local data/real/lalonde.csv is 27,509 bytes with SHA-256 a49703ca0233ba0a27fa9cda959a38a07f6825def0f7743cf2380ce4e57dd3ef, matching the recorded expected size and hash.

claims.statement: The data-value license remains unresolved_upstream; package-level licensing is not silently assigned to the data values.
The audit records observation_count 614.
All ten declared column records are present, and the total number of missing declared cells is zero.
The audit records exact_duplicate_record_count 0.
The audit records duplicate_unit_or_unit_epoch_ids as empty.
The audit counts five repeated measurement vectors excluding the identifier; these remain warnings, not proof of duplicate people.
Every declared adjustment feature is available at or before the 1975 pre-NSW baseline and carries the pre_treatment_adjustment role in the contract.
re78 is declared under contract outcome and is not among the adjustment features; adjustment therefore excludes the outcome column.
re74 and re75 carry the frozen log1p transform; every other declared adjustment feature uses the identity transform.
The split strategy is entity_hash keyed by the protocol salt causal-ml-lalonde-protocol-v1-no-outcome-tuning; assignment is deterministic for a given salt.
The declared train, calibration and holdout fractions are 0.6, 0.2 and 0.2 of entity-hashed rows.
The audit's leakage checks report zero train/calibration, train/holdout and calibration/holdout unit overlap, with entity-disjoint verification true.
No epoch is present, so temporal separation is unavailable rather than verified (epoch_disjoint_verified is false); entity-disjoint splitting is the only implemented role separation for this CSV.
The predeclared estimator cross_fitted_aipw_logistic_linear_v1 uses 5 train folds; nuisance fits are separated from evaluation on the held-out folds.
The propensity model is a main-effects logistic IRLS fit with maximum 100 iterations, tolerance 1E-8, and fixed ridge 1E-6.
The primary propensity clip is 0.05.
The predeclared sensitivity propensity clips are 0.01 and 0.1.
The outcome models are separate treatment-level ridge-linear least squares on standardized contract features; predictions are not truncated to nonnegative earnings.
The holdout ledger records exactly one final-only event, H001-final-only; the ledger is a local record, not a tamper-proof timestamp authority.
The report records access_sequence 1 for the single final holdout evaluation.
The report records reused_for_tuning false for the holdout evaluation.

The frozen protocol dossier names the declared baseline features and transforms, outcome exclusion, entity-hash split roles and fractions, the cross-fitted IRLS logistic propensity with treatment-level ridge-linear outcome models, the frozen clips, and the single final-only holdout event with access sequence 1 and no tuning reuse. It is a reproducibility dossier of mixed factual and empirical records, not an identification proof; MIXED_DOSSIER obligations apply.
The generated report gives an all-observation unadjusted mean difference of -635.0 nominal dollars (rounded for prose); this is explicitly association_only.

At the frozen 0.05 clip, the generated train cross-fitted AIPW summary is -269.3 with influence-function SE 1023.1 and normal 95 percent interval [-2274.4, 1735.9], all in nominal dollars after rounding.

At the frozen 0.05 clip, the generated single holdout external-nuisance AIPW summary is 426.3 with influence-function SE 1821.9 and normal 95 percent interval [-3144.6, 3997.3], all in nominal dollars after rounding.

At predeclared sensitivity clip 0.01, the generated holdout external-nuisance AIPW summary is 1137.4 with normal 95 percent interval [-3173.6, 5448.3], in nominal dollars after rounding; the selection rule forbids choosing a preferred clip by results.

At predeclared sensitivity clip 0.10, the generated holdout external-nuisance AIPW summary is 75.5 with normal 95 percent interval [-2443.2, 2594.3], in nominal dollars after rounding; the selection rule forbids choosing a preferred clip by results.
At diagnostic thresholds fixed in the contract, 138 of 366 train rows (37.70 percent) have raw estimated propensity outside [0.05, 0.95], indicating material estimated-overlap weakness on train.
At diagnostic thresholds fixed in the contract, 41 of 134 holdout rows (30.60 percent) have raw estimated propensity outside [0.05, 0.95], indicating material estimated-overlap weakness on holdout.

All five recorded train-fold propensity fits report converged true and separation_suspected false, in 7 IRLS iterations each; numerical convergence does not establish identification or model correctness.

The deployed propensity fit on the train rows reports converged true and separation_suspected false, in 7 IRLS iterations; numerical convergence does not establish identification or model correctness.
Neither balance nor AIPW fit rules out unmeasured selection between NSW participants and PSID comparisons; adjusted intervals are not hidden-confounding bounds.
No target-population sampling design or effect-modifier transport formula is supplied, so the computed sample contrast does not establish effects in other populations or periods.
Normal-reference influence-function intervals address one sampling approximation only; clipping sensitivity is a set of alternate weighted estimates, not a sensitivity analysis for hidden bias.
Any future deployment needs versioned feature timestamps, role-specific data audits, drift and override monitoring, and rollback criteria; none is implemented as a production service here.

Canonical hashes, exact expression rules, cycle checks, and registered candidates reconstruct an administrative argument dossier; Lean execution, independent process replay, and scientific approval remain outside this checker.

Only if the causal question, identification premises, measurement model, target support, and protocol were substantively established could the adjusted contrast receive the stated split-specific causal interpretation; the holdout sensitivity clips 0.01, 0.05 and 0.10 diverge from one another. This project explicitly leaves that scientific verification unresolved; the dossier is conditional only and establishes no causal effect.
